actual_native_visual_review.verdict_zh: 完整247帧已核验并查看：树叶接缝闪动减轻，但人物附近仍有局部纹理变化；新版并非各处都优于上一版，全片画质待验收。
actual_native_visual_review.background_acceptance_scope: Material background drift and VAE context reset reduced; subtle texture changes need full-speed user acceptance. No claim of exactly zero RGB variation.

fixed_wall_edges.scope: Fixed clear wall edges only, not person or cast-shadow boundaries.
